Definition: from G706; to enumerate or count:--number.
BiblicalUsage: To number is to count, and Scripture uses it for the smallest and the largest counts alike. Jesus says the very hairs of your head are all numbered, and John sees a multitude no man could number standing before the throne.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the numbering of hairs is the most tender arithmetic in the Bible: nothing about you is too small for God to count. And the multitude no one could number is the other end of the same truth, that His people are more than any census will ever hold.
